desc.en: Specially synthesized nutrients, made so even plants affected by the Dusk can grow. It's indispensable to farmers, but its high demand has led to steep price increases.
desc.ja: 黄昏でも植物が育つようにと特別に調合された栄養剤。今や農家には欠かせない薬剤だが、昨今は需要過多で値段が高騰している

desc.en: Effect: Increases sell price at shops by a good amount.
desc.ja: 効果：お店の買取価格がけっこう上がる

desc.en: Effect: Reduces necessary Search Equipment frames by 1. Cannot be reduced lower than 1.
desc.ja: 効果：探索装備の装備枠を１つ減らす。最低でも装備枠は１つになる

desc.en: Increases transfer PP by 7 when this item is used as a material in Synthesis.
desc.ja: この潜力のついた材料を使って調合すると、引き継ぎＰＰ枠が７増加する

desc.en: Increases the chances of finding better materials in the field.
desc.ja: フィールドで、より良い素材を発見できる可能性が高くなる

desc.en: Greatly increases the chances of finding better materials in the field.
desc.ja: フィールドで、より良い素材を発見できる可能性が非常に高くなる

desc.en: Increases the number of materials obtained when gathering in the field.
desc.ja: フィールドで、一度に採取できる素材の数が増える
